verdict.rationale: Composio's first-party triggers docs say that events in connected apps (a new Slack message, a GitHub commit, an incoming email) are sent to your app as structured payloads. Every trigger event is POSTed, signed, to one webhook URL registered per project, so the agent can react to events instead of polling. Missing for 10: docs on how to enable or subscribe to specific triggers per user or connection, the breadth of the trigger catalog, any filtering or retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
